segments.name: Burn Care
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and sells NexoBrid and other enzymatic biologics that remove dead tissue in burn and chronic wound patients.
segments.evidence: Our flagship product, NexoBrid, is a topically administered biological orphan drug that enzymatically removes eschar while preserving viable tissue in patients with deep partial- and full-thickness thermal burns.

revenueModel.text: Hospitals and physicians in approved markets pay for NexoBrid and other biologics used to treat burns and wounds.
revenueModel.evidence: With robust in-house research, development, and manufacturing capabilities, the company produces and commercializes cutting-edge biologics for wound and burn care that exceed existing standards of care, improve patient outcomes, and reduce healthcare costs by eliminating the need for surgical interventions.
